//: Route matrix for scripts/ci/render-smoke.mjs. Keep it small enough to gate every PR; the wide sweep belongs in a scheduled job.
//routes: Locale-relative. Expanded against every locale above.
//absentNamespaces: The scoping invariant. A namespace listed here must NOT reach this route's payload. Environment-independent: it compares against a sentinel string taken from messages/en, so it does not care how much seeded content CI has. If the layout ever goes back to shipping the whole catalog, every one of these fails at once.
//knownBroken: Empty, and it should stay that way. It briefly held four routes on 2026-08-26 — two guide pages rendering 45 raw key paths between them, and the zh/ar site-visit checklists broken by a machine-translated enum. All four were fixed the same day rather than left listed. The gate FAILS on any key path not listed here, and also fails if a listed route turns out clean, so an entry cannot quietly outlive the bug it describes.
//extraRoutes: Not locale-expanded. The two known-broken pages are here so the allowlist is exercised and shrinks visibly when someone fixes the keys.
